checks.label: Start with the last operation and work back to the first

Each puzzle accepts only its own answer, and every wrong answer offered is the one a named slip gives, and every wrong number (a wrong undo carried on to its x) fails its check: the step written first taken as done first; the first step undone first; a step done again instead of undone; the 20 halved but not the 6; a divide undone by dividing or by taking away; or a sign dropped across zero

Every picture, finished, draws the steps in order, each undo box under the step it undoes, the answer and its check; each jump on the number line runs from the right side to the first undo; and a wrong answer's check fails in the warning colour, clear of its name
Before an answer, nothing in a puzzle's picture shows the answer

Every demonstration has finished arriving within 4.5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion within 2.5 s and a slip's within 1.6 s; parts start at least 0.45 s apart, each once the travel before it has ended
